name: zcode-bilingual
description: Hover ZCode UI text to see a translation tooltip: English UI shows Chinese, Chinese UI shows English. The original text and the layout are never modified. v0.5.0 adds a live layer: a local service delivers a hot dictionary (new plugins translate within minutes, no re-patch) and translates unknown text on hover via a configurable LLM backend, caching every answer forever.

description_i18n.en: Hover ZCode UI text to see a translation tooltip: English UI shows Chinese, Chinese UI shows English. The original text and the layout are never modified. Catalog-driven surfaces are covered automatically; plugin/skill/subagent/MCP metadata is covered by an extensible dictionary.json.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 鼠标悬停在 ZCode 界面文案上时浮出另一种语言的翻译气泡：英文界面显示中文，中文界面显示英文。原有文字与排版完全不动。v0.5.0 新增实时层：本地服务提供热词典（新装插件几分钟内免重打直接可译），词典未命中的文案悬停时通过可配置的 LLM 后端现场翻译，并永久缓存每个结果。翻译模型不写死：会话窗口 Ctrl+Alt+M 呼出面板自选，或在 live-config.json 手动填写 "model"，保存即生效。
